create.name: Suzi Lula
create.bio:
Suzi Lula is a spiritual counsellor and teacher based in Los Angeles, where she has served on the faculty of the Agape International Spiritual Center, the New Thought community founded by Michael Bernard Beckwith. She trained at the University of Santa Monica, earning a master's degree in spiritual psychology, and has kept a counselling practice since 1997. Over the years she has spoken and run workshops at Centers for Spiritual Living and other spiritual communities across the United States.

Her central theme is what she calls soul care: treating care of oneself as a spiritual discipline rather than an indulgence, built on vision, meditation, self-compassion and inspired action. Much of her work speaks to mothers, and her book The Motherhood Evolution argues that a parent who flourishes helps a family flourish. She teaches through recorded online classes, a certification for coaches and counsellors in her soul care approach, private sessions, and her weekly Permission to Thrive podcast, which mixes conversations with guided practices. She is also a composer and pianist, and she and her husband, the singer Jami Lula, have led group journeys abroad.

books.title: The Motherhood Evolution: How Thriving Mothers Raise Thriving Children
books.author: Suzi Lula
books.description: Her book for mothers on making care of oneself a spiritual priority. It sets out why a parent's own wellbeing shapes the life of the whole family, with practices drawn from her counselling work.

courses.title: Self Care as a Spiritual Practice
courses.description: A recorded four-class course built on the four pillars she uses in her own life. It moves from clarifying a life vision and starting a meditation practice to working with beliefs and taking inspired action.

courses.title: WORTHY!
courses.description: An online course for parents on living and parenting from a sense of being enough. It offers practices for bringing spirituality into family life, with a private online group for questions.

courses.title: Soul Care Coaching Certification
courses.description: A training in her soul care approach to spiritual psychology for coaches, counsellors, educators and others. It combines live and recorded teaching, observed sessions, guided processes and small practice groups.

courses.title: Spiritual Counseling with Suzi Lula
courses.description: Private, group and longer immersion sessions with her as a spiritual counsellor. She takes a limited number of clients, and enquiries go through her contact page.

free_resources.title: Meditation Starter Kit for Parents
free_resources.description: A free kit for parents who want to begin meditating. It includes a chapter on mothers who meditate, a short webinar and three recorded meditations for morning, afternoon and evening, sent after sign-up.
